seo.title: About Verde Law, a Humanitarian Immigration Firm
seo.description: A Miami-based firm founded by an immigrant, for immigrants. Thousands of families served across all 50 states.

about.title: Built by an immigrant, for immigrants.
about.subtitle: Verde Law was founded on a simple belief: that every immigrant in the United States deserves legal representation that's personal, accessible, and relentless.

story.title: From Havana to the courtroom.
story.p1: Rafael Verde's path to founding Verde Law didn't start in a law library. It started in a small town on the outskirts of Havana, where he grew up in a close-knit community that taught him two things early: the importance of standing up for others, and the reality that sometimes the system you're born into isn't built for you.
story.p2: When his family emigrated to South Florida, Rafael adapted fast, but he never forgot what it felt like to arrive somewhere new with nothing but hope. He went through Doral Academy, earned a degree in Public Relations and Communications at Florida International University, and spent years learning how to give people a voice before realizing the people who needed it most were sitting in immigration courtrooms with no one to speak for them. That realization led him to Barry University School of Law, and then, weeks after passing the bar, to founding Verde Law.
story.p3: The firm wasn't built to be the biggest. It was built to be the one that treats every case the way Rafael's own family deserved to be treated when they arrived: with urgency, with honesty, and with an attorney who genuinely understands what's on the line because he's been on the other side of that fear.
story.p4: Today, Verde Law is a team of attorneys, paralegals, and support staff serving immigrant families in all 50 states. The cases are bigger, the team is stronger, and the reach is wider. But every new client still gets the same thing Rafael promised from day one: someone who fights for your family like it's their own.

mission.title: Why we do this.
mission.quote: We believe every immigrant deserves quality legal representation, regardless of their financial situation, regardless of their status, regardless of where they come from.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Flat fees. Payment plans. Free consultations. Full service in English and Spanish. Representation should never depend on who you know or what you can pay up front.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.desc: We prepare every case as if it's going to federal court. Evidence binders, expert declarations, mock hearings. The standard of preparation doesn't change based on what a client can afford.

humanity.title: Humanity
humanity.desc: The people sitting across from us are scared, exhausted, and running out of options. We meet them with patience and respect every single time. That's not a bonus, that's the baseline.
